Services

Four things I do exceptionally well.

I join your team as a senior engineer or technical lead, own the hard part of the system, and leave it documented, tested and observable.

AI orchestration & agentic engineering

Bring LLMs into products and engineering teams the safe way. I design agent loops that plan, call your tools and data, and verify their own work, on Azure OpenAI or Anthropic Claude. I also build custom Claude skills and hooks that encode your team's workflows and guardrails.

Anthropic ClaudeAzure OpenAIAgent loopsAgentic workflowsSkills & hooksGovernance

You get: AI that ships real work, with guardrails your compliance team can sign off.

Microservices & event-driven integration

Microservices that communicate through Service Bus, Event Grid and Functions to synchronise orders, payments and master data in real time, with retries and dead-letter handling designed in.

MicroservicesService BusEvent GridNServiceBusRabbitMQ

You get: systems that stay consistent when parts fail.

Backend modernisation

Move legacy platforms to modern .NET without losing business rules. I have rewritten Java systems in .NET and run legacy .NET Framework services side by side with the latest .NET during a staged migration.

Modern .NET.NET FrameworkLegacy migrationDDDEF Core

You get: a maintainable codebase and a migration you can stage.

Regulated-data platforms

Healthcare, social security, tax and Solvency II systems where tenant isolation, secrets management, testing and traceability are non-negotiable.

Key VaultMulti-tenantxUnit · TDDDynatrace

You get: fewer production incidents and cleaner audits.

Retail · food service

Food-service ordering platform

Ordering and payments for international fast-food brands

2024 – 2025
Challenge
Real-time orders, payments and loyalty across mobile, web and kiosk, for several brands and countries, at thousands of daily transactions.

Approach

How a mission runs.

Clear checkpoints, no surprises. You see working software early and often.

Understand

Read the code, the data and the constraints. Confirm what success looks like and what must not break.

Design

Propose two or three options with their trade-offs in testability, cost and risk. You pick.

Deliver

Small, reviewed increments through your CI/CD, each with tests in the same change.

Hand over

Monitoring, documentation and knowledge transfer so your team runs it confidently after I leave.
